name: screenguard
description: ScreenGuard — Never accidentally share what you shouldn't.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build -c vite.worker.config.ts && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
